title: The skills decide-together and get-connected overlap. Merge them, or keep both with sharper descriptions?

options.label: Merge into decide-together

options.label: Keep both, sharpen descriptions
options.one_line_preview: If you pick this, both stay and their descriptions are rewritten so they no longer read alike.
